caption_instagram:
From 1 December, your money waits until the title deed is yours 🔐🇹🇷

Türkiye's Secure Payment System for property sales becomes mandatory on 1 December 2026:
✅ The buyer pays into the system, not straight to the seller
✅ The money goes to the seller only after the deed is registered to the buyer
✅ If the sale falls through, the payment goes back to the buyer
✅ A bank-financed (mortgage) part stays outside the system; the rest goes through
⚠️ The seller pays a usage fee, deducted from the price. The amount had not been announced as of 20 Nov 2026
⚠️ The start date already moved twice (1 Jul → 1 Oct → 1 Dec), so recheck the rules before your appointment
